description: Run multimodal VLM layout, typography, and aesthetic anti-slop review on a rendered deliverable and return structured layout/typography findings with fix guidance (2 credits, sign-in required). Provide exactly one of `imageBase64`, `url`, or `html`.

html.description: Mutually exclusive with imageBase64/url: standalone HTML snippet to render headlessly and inspect

imageBase64.description: Mutually exclusive with url/html: Base64-encoded PNG, JPEG, or WebP screenshot to inspect

lang.description: Output language for review notes and actionable fix guidance (zh or en)

protect.description: Up to 12 brand, layout, or copy constraints that review recommendations must preserve

targetType.description: Deliverable format used to select visual anti-slop rubric (webpage, slide, poster, infographic, diagram, comic, or print)

url.description: Mutually exclusive with imageBase64/html: public HTTPS webpage URL to render and inspect

name: dislop_visual_review
